changes.evidence: On 2 August 1941 , U-96 left for her sixth patrol in the North Atlantic .
On 12 August , the U-boat was part of group Greenland .
on 28 August , she joined group Prince-Elector .
In early September , U-96 belonged to group Seawolf before returning to base .
On 12 September she entered St.Nazaire after 42 days at sea , without attacking any ships .
